offering_description.value: Taylor Morrison builds and sells homes to first-time, move-up and active-adult buyers. It acquires and develops land, builds homes in planned communities and develops single-family rental communities for investors. It also offers mortgage and title services to homebuyers.

primary_products.value: detached single-family homes; townhomes; single-family rental communities

primary_services.value: mortgage origination; title and settlement services

customer_segment.value: B2C: First-time buyers, move-up buyers and active adults; B2B: Institutional buyers of single-family rental communities

end_markets.value: owner-occupied housing; active-adult housing; single-family rental housing

revenue_model.value: product sales: New homes and completed rental communities; service fees: Mortgage origination, title and settlement services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Develops land and uses trade contractors to build homes for households and rental communities for investors; financial intermediary: Originates mortgages for homebuyers and sells loans to mortgage investors; service provider: Provides title and settlement services to homebuyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; financial intermediary; service provider

geography_served.value: US national: Selected markets across the western, southern and midwestern United States

specialization.value: related lines: For-sale homebuilding, single-family rental development, mortgage origination and title services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Company sales teams serving homebuyers and institutional purchasers; own locations: Model homes and sales centers in residential communities; agents / brokers: Independent real estate agents who bring buyers to communities
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Local zoning, building codes and permits govern construction, and state licensing and federal consumer lending rules govern mortgage origination.

notes: The extent of direct rental operations within its wholly owned portfolio is uncertain.
